claims.claim: TOMMY warns about deterioration of fixed coastal equipment and the need to inspect tree anchors. Check sea conditions, tides, wind and the actual stance, even if photographs show dry rock. If you cannot assess the coastal setting, do not rappel in before establishing an exit. ROCKTOPO highlights December through April as its season reference, which does not guarantee conditions on a particular day. For an April trip, keep the outdoor day flexible rather than tying your only climbing day to a sea cliff.
